semantics.GP: separate per-gamma bounded posteriors over committed successful executed windows, re-embedded at each round by the current model endpoint phi
semantics.D: all executed suffix starts reconstructed from the scheduled number of distinct commit-capable successful trajectories per gamma and round, selected by random_success; each available suffix of length <=H is reverified and must be valid with positive progress, then zero-padded only for fixed-shape embedding with CFM loss masked to its valid horizon
semantics.D_plus: reverified valid positive-progress executed <=H suffixes from commit-capable terminal successes
semantics.replay_acceptance: successful-window archive admission overrides per-query replay acceptance: only reverified valid positive-progress executed <=H suffixes from committed terminal successes are replayed
semantics.execution: positive-per-knot-x verifier positives ranked by min_cost; nominal one-step H_P is diagnostic only
semantics.failure: NVP terminates that episode; no expert fallback
semantics.replay: most recent 3 rounds of D+ selected by uniform; then gamma-lineage-context-query equal mass
semantics.negative_replay: none: NVP, collision, OOB, and timeout trajectories are discarded in full
semantics.candidate_perturbation: one Gaussian action vector per candidate applied with scope=coherent_horizon before embedding and verification
semantics.flow_base_sampling: expansion-only initial flow latent x0~N(0,1I), applied before flow integration; sample-update pairs guided and unguided cohorts at the same round-scheduled std in every batch; raw evaluation remains unit normal
semantics.representation: paired noised phi_s using each sampled plan's stored initial CFM base
semantics.gp_reference: per-gamma bounded cumulative successful-window evidence through the previous round, re-embedded by current endpoint phi
semantics.acquisition_diagnostics: ESS_over_K is the mean sequential conditional normalized ESS over B without-replacement draws; marginal_ESS_over_K is the first-draw Gibbs ESS/K computed from marginal sigma_K; uplift compares selected marginal sigma with the all-K marginal mean
semantics.successful_executed_windows: after gathering, choose the scheduled number of distinct terminal SUCCESS trajectories per gamma, ranked by successful_trajectory_selector, filtered to exact mode quota for that round/gamma cell; reconstruct all L suffix starts from consecutive actually executed first actions; reverify only the available <=H states and commit valid positive-progress suffixes; zero-pad to H for frozen-phi embedding and mask CFM loss to the available actions; recompute their sigma against the round-start GP; selection is admission ranking only and never changes validity or NVP; retry whole batches until every gamma has the requested number of commit-capable terminal SUCCESS trajectories, with top-fraction replay grouped by (round,gamma) and complete sigma-boundary ties retained
semantics.episode_retry: up to 1 whole-episode batches per gamma, 24 episodes per cohort in paired guided/unguided cohorts; stop a gamma after accumulating its scheduled commit-capable terminal SUCCESS trajectories satisfying exact mode quota for that round/gamma cell; later successes in already-full modes are not committed; no step retry; exhaustion aborts the round before archive, GP, optimizer, or checkpoint mutation; counter-keyed gather RNG coordinates are (seed,round,retry_batch,replica,step) and deliberately exclude gamma and cohort so guided/unguided replicas use paired bases

gp_reference.paired_success_window_base: concatenated actual first-action generator latents from successive closed-loop decisions; terminal padding is zero
gp_reference.eviction: equal successful-trajectory quotas with uniformly spaced departure-to-tail window starts; cumulative evidence log retained
gp_reference.window_source: every reverified available <=H suffix of actually executed controls from up to 12 distinct commit-capable terminal SUCCESS trajectories per gamma/round; zero-padded for fixed-shape phi with valid-horizon CFM masks

lab_conditioning.event_context: 7-D low state plus prior raw-command history when present plus verifier-only dynamics/scene suffix; visual grid omitted because it is reproducible from robot state and scene

step_margin_blend.proximity_cost: required zero when weight is positive

bounded_regret_margin_hybrid.formula: among selected-B candidates with J <= J_min + fraction*(J_max-J_min), maximize first-step nominal H_P margin; break ties by lower J

native_soft_clearance.scope: execution ranking only; verifier labels unchanged

native_taskspace_exponential.scope: execution ranking only; verifier first-step taskspace gate and rollout OOB termination unchanged

execution_taskspace_quadratic.scope: execution ranking only; verifier and rollout OOB termination unchanged

execution_axis_cylinder_quadratic.scope: execution ranking only; uncapped axis preserves axial goal progress; verifier and rollout unchanged

execution_obstacle_conditioned_speed.scope: execution ranking only; bounded proximity gate; verifier/acquisition/dynamics unchanged

execution_clearance_exponential.scope: H post-action plan knots; execution ranking only; verifier/acquisition/rollout termination unchanged

obstacle_plane_escape.symmetry: symmetric in z about the obstacle centre plane; upward and downward escape are relieved equally
obstacle_plane_escape.gate: horizontal pass-by disc around the obstacle centre, so the start and goal on the same plane are not penalized
obstacle_plane_escape.scope: execution ranking only; verifier labels, replay admission, episode termination, and CFM targets unchanged

lab_verifier.tight_corridor_contract: lab configured taskspace/geofence only; canonical ball [0,3] x [1.5,2.5] bounds are not used
lab_verifier.progress: strictly positive at every plan knot along the fixed start-goal unit axis

lab_coverage_objective.sample_update_mode_classifier: scene state metadata: paired_scene_label = 2*pair_slot + member (internal admission label, not a route mode)
lab_coverage_objective.sample_update_retry_guidance: every retry batch keeps K/B acquisition active and launches equal attempts on every distinct frozen original/axis_180 scene-pair slot; exactly one success per pair-slot/member label is committed

lab_scene_randomization.distribution_rationale: Six-sphere dense-z double-hourglass law in the PRE2 taskspace z=[0.1,1.7]. The longitudinal support [0.20,0.80] reserves endpoint space. Sphere centers are symmetric about z=0.9 and clipped to [0.7,1.1]; the hourglass half-width profile remains tighter near its pinch. The goal-side y minimum is moved from -1.7 to -2.1 m so the goal-to-y-min clearance is 0.6 m.
lab_scene_randomization.geometry_contract: Six 15-inch physical spheres (radius 0.1905 m), each inflated by robot radius 0.05 m to modeled radius 0.2405 m. Modeled surfaces have at least 0.20 m clearance, hence center distance is at least 2*0.2405+0.20=0.681 m. H_P context and NVP safety consume the same modeled sphere rows and taskspace bounds.

lab_scene_rng_contract.reset: Q/2 distinct deterministic frozen original/axis_180 scene pairs per round and gamma; retries change rollout latents only
lab_scene_rng_contract.flow_latent: generic gather generator deterministically salted by the gamma stored in each learned context
lab_scene_rng_contract.mode_labels_or_quota: pair-slot/member admission labels 0..Q-1; no route labels

lab_paired_scene_quota.replacement_semantics: incomplete-pair commit-capable terminal-success trigger; replacement invalidates both labels, increments scene version, and requires both members to be recollected
lab_paired_scene_quota.pair_admission: one original plus one axis_180 success for every distinct frozen round/gamma/pair-slot geometry; label successes accumulate across retry batches and surplus successes are excluded from the exact final commit

paired_success_mirror_proposal.safety_contract: no new label or fast path; proposal eligibility is exactly Verification.valid && progress_eligible && target_eligible when the existing target gate is active

event_log_contract.event_record: the unchanged complete compact event dict for every K/B/sigma/verifier/execution step of every resolved terminal-SUCCESS episode; manifest IDs identify the authoritative plural committed subset

reserve_g_online_optimization.batch_semantics: row-permutation exact replay pass with equal-mass gamma->trajectory->window weighting; paired members are separate equal-mass trajectories
reserve_g_online_optimization.sample_archive_contract: query_archive_round_NNN.pt is written atomically after every committed round; query_archive.pt merges all committed rounds

paired_scene_replacement_diagnostics.contract: at/after the configured completed retry-batch index, replace only an incomplete current-version slot whose original or axis-180 member lacks a commit-capable terminal success; discard both labels and recollect both on the fresh version
